_readme: XLayer (196) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/xlayer.json ./scripts/seed.sh xlayer [--broadcast]. WETH kind = the chain's wrapped-native WOKB (weth9 0xe538..9b2b, from contracts/deployments/xlayer.json); the seeder auto-wraps native OKB if short. tHOOK/tUSDC are fresh MINT test tokens. priceAperB values are DEMO ratios (tUSDC is a test token, not a real quote). Gas is paid in OKB (base fee ~0.021 gwei; chains.json sets a 0.05 gwei floor). Amounts are DEMO-scale; size to the funded deployer balance before --broadcast. NOTE: XLayer already has a prior WOKB/SeedTestToken proof pool; these formalize repeatable v2+v3 seeds.
